stories.title: Fusion CX IPO sees 41% subscription on Day 1, 12% grey‑market premium
stories.summary: The Fusion CX IPO, priced at Rs 275‑289 per share, attracted a 41% subscription on its first day of bidding. The Rs 702 crore issue is trading with a 12% grey‑market premium, reflecting expectations of listing gains. Brokers cite the company’s strong financial growth and rising demand for AI‑driven customer‑experience solutions as reasons to consider a long‑term hold.
stories.why: The subscription level and grey‑market premium indicate strong investor interest and potential short‑term price movement.

stories.title: Reliance shares watched as Jio IPO price band announced
stories.summary: The Economic Times reported that Reliance Industries’ stock is in focus after the price band for Jio’s initial public offering was set, with the IPO described as potentially one of the largest ever issued. The excerpt does not provide the specific price range or further details about the offering.
stories.why: Investors monitor IPO pricing because it can influence Reliance’s valuation and broader market sentiment.

stories.title: Student protesters attack government buildings in Albania
stories.summary: Thousands of students have taken to the streets in the Albanian capital of Tirana, attacking several government buildings on the second day of violent anti-government protests. Albania's Deputy Prime Minister ​Albana Koçiu has called for "calmness, self-restraint and maturity" and said "Albania does not need to burn to change".
stories.why: This matters because it could affect economic conditions, trade, technology, public systems or international decisions.
stories.previousTitle: Student protests in Tirana turn violent, targeting ministry buildings
stories.previousSummary: Thousands of students marched in Tirana, beginning outside the Ministry of Education on Tuesday to demand better university conditions and job prospects. On the following day, part of the education ministry building was set on fire and the prime minister’s office, finance and interior ministries, as well as nearby businesses, were attacked. Protesters wearing gas masks and balaclavas threw rocks and firecrackers at the ministry gates.

stories.title: US inflation rises more than expected
stories.summary: US inflation rose by more than expected in the year to September, according to official figures, in the final data release before the midterm elections next month.
stories.why: Inflation data can shift expectations for central-bank interest rates, bond yields, borrowing costs and household purchasing power.
stories.previousTitle: US inflation exceeds forecasts for year to September
stories.previousSummary: Official data show that US inflation rose more than forecasters expected for the 12‑month period ending in September. The increase was driven by higher petrol prices after disruptions to Middle‑East energy supplies linked to the US‑Israel conflict with Iran. The release comes in the final data set before the midterm elections, where cost‑of‑living issues dominate campaign discussion.
